description: Date of the GitHub event (release: published_at truncated to YYYY-MM-DD; deployment: created_at truncated to YYYY-MM-DD). Used as the primary time dimension for context_events rows. Platform contract field carried from the module manifest; official-name divergence (if any) is documented in ROLLOUT_NOTES.md and adjudicated by the 25.6 live probe.
Unique integer identifier for the release object returned by the GitHub REST API.
Git tag that identifies the release (e.g. 'v2.3.1'). Used as the event label in context_events.
Human-readable title of the release. Falls back to tag_name when null. Stored as context_event description.
Markdown release notes body. Available in the API response; not currently extracted to context_events.
True when the release is a draft (unpublished). Draft releases have no published_at timestamp.
True when the release is marked as a pre-release (e.g. alpha, beta, RC).
ISO-8601 timestamp when the release object was created in GitHub (may precede publication).
ISO-8601 timestamp when the release was published. Null for draft releases. Source of the 'date' dimension for the releases profile.
Branch name or commit SHA the release tag points to (e.g. 'main', 'v2-stable').
GitHub login (username) of the user who created the release.
Unique integer identifier for the deployment object returned by the GitHub REST API.
Branch name, tag, or commit SHA that was deployed (e.g. 'main', 'v2.3.1'). Used in the event label.
Target deployment environment name (e.g. 'production', 'staging', 'preview'). Used in the event label.
The initial environment name before any promotion/redirection. May differ from environment after a pipeline changes the target.
Deployment task name (typically 'deploy' or 'deploy:migrations'). Describes the type of deployment action.
Full commit SHA that was deployed. Useful for correlating deployments with specific code changes.
Short human-readable description of the deployment, supplied at creation time. May be null.
ISO-8601 timestamp when the deployment was created. Source of the 'date' dimension for the deployments profile.
ISO-8601 timestamp of the last status update for the deployment.
True when the deployment environment is ephemeral (e.g. a per-PR preview environment).
True when the target environment is the production environment.
GitHub login (username) of the user or bot that triggered the deployment.
GitHub repository owner (user or organization name). Supplied via connection_config at pull time; not a field in the release/deployment payload itself.
GitHub repository name. Supplied via connection_config at pull time; not a field in the release/deployment payload itself.
